summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains operational and financial performance highlights, including production of 45.2 MMboe, project updates (Scarborough, Trion, Louisiana LNG), and guidance. It also notes the appointment of Liz Westcott as CEO. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven transaction is disclosed.
